title: The 1933 Nobel citation: chromosomes in heredity
summary: The Nobel Foundation credits Thomas Hunt Morgan with discoveries concerning the role of the chromosome in heredity.
body: The Nobel Prize API record for 1933 says Thomas H. Morgan received the prize in physiology or medicine for his discoveries concerning the role played by the chromosome in heredity. The record dates the award 20 October 1933. A separate card already records the 1956 count of 46 human chromosomes. This card is Morgan's prize sentence, not that count.
